description: Use this when someone asks to run or trigger a cron job now. Returns only that Croncool invoked it, not the target's response. Each call immediately sends the job's configured request again, which can write, message or bill downstream, and a repeated call sends it once more. Not for checking a run's result.

jobId.description: Job id (uuid) of the one job to run

name: run_job

status.description: Croncool invoked the job; the outcome is recorded in the job's run history

title: Run a cron job now
